newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR TO GAIN FIM 18 MLN ON REAL ESTATE.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR TO GAIN FIM 18 MLN ON REAL ESTATE.

text.p: Finnish food and sweetener group Cultor Oy said on Wednesday it would sell its head office in Helsinki to pension incurance company Verdandi for 130 million markka and book an 18 million markka net gain.
"The result impact of the deal after taxes is about 18 million markka," Cultor said in a statement, adding the deal would also have a "clearly positive" impact on cashflow.
According to a letter of intent, Cultor would lease the office for 10 years, it said.
Cultor had also agreed to buy and renovate a piece of real estate in Espoo for group management from the Finnish state, Cultor said, but did not give a price of that deal.
The real estate deals are part of programme which aims at developing Cultor's decentralised group structure, it said.
